schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group routine crates.io updates into one weekly PR to keep noise low. Every PR is gated by the full CI matrix (build, test, cargo-deny, bridge codegen drift, public API stability).

flutter_rust_bridge is pinned `=2.11.1` and MUST move in lockstep with the codegen CLI version (FRB_CODEGEN_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml) and the install instructions in README.md / CONTRIBUTING.md. A skewed CLI reformats the generated bridge and the codegen-drift job fails spuriously. Never auto-merge: open the PR, but require a human to update the CLI pin + docs in the same change.

Pre-release tari_* crates (5.3.1-pre.0) can change struct/enum shape between pre-releases. The `From<minotari::…>` conversions and the enum-mapping tests are the early warning. Never auto-merge; review the conversions when this lands.

customManagers.description: Track the git-pinned `minotari` rev so Renovate proposes digest (rev) updates from the minotari-cli default branch. Cargo's native git-rev digest support is limited; this regex manager pins the lookup explicitly. A bump here MUST re-verify the `From<minotari::…>` conversions (transactions.rs, balance.rs, fee.rs, scanner.rs, base_node.rs) — see CONTRIBUTING.md. Never auto-merge.
